resource_reads.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'for f in skill/references/short-lived-workflows.md skill/references/executor-selection.md skill/references/safety-and-uncertainty.md skill/assets/templates/workflow-design.md; do echo "===== $f"; sed -n '"'1,360p' \""'$f"; done'

decision.rationale: This is an explicitly one-off, short-lived relationship-repair task whose value depends on changing-goal conversation and prose judgment. The exact intake and receipt rules can be enforced as an Agent checklist, while human approval contains semantic and side-effect risk; a local runner would add interface and maintenance cost without safely delivering the qualitative desk receipt unattended.
